experiment: Creation-only materializer versus the original immutable per-cell mutation path

protocol.sourceGuard: Benchmark asserts that public Table and checkout-local Table have identical class identity.
protocol.baseline: Only the post-validation record-construction block was temporarily restored to its original implementation; it was restored to DOD before delivery.
protocol.algorithmPairs: Legacy spec.mutate(emptyRecord) and DOD materializer share the same prepared specs. Pair order alternates every round.
protocol.fullCreation: Public Table.createRecords retains records, mutation specs and key mappings; event emission disabled. No database, HTTP or permissions timing.
protocol.memory: heapAfterCreate - heapBefore is a post-operation snapshot, not peak heap or total allocation. Retained snapshots use explicit GC and include runtime noise.
protocol.measurementKind: Explicit-GC profiles captured before TinyBench timing loops; these are not the loop statistics.
protocol.timingLoopInterpretation: The companion is the aggregate Vitest loop report, including means, variance, RME and sampleCount. Individual samples are omitted by Vitest. A 500-field prepared-spec materialization ratio of about 4.75x follows from its legacy/DOD means, not from the GC profiles.
protocol.expandedBulkScope: Domain primitives only; stream creation includes shared metadata preparation; update/reapply pairs measure prepared-spec materialization, not whole commands.
cautions: Non-dedicated workstation; large wall-time variability. Do not treat these runs as an end-to-end latency guarantee.
Only synthetic singleLineText workloads are timed, including text typecast. Other cell types are correctness-tested, not performance-characterized.
Earlier runs with workspace links resolving to the primary checkout were invalid and excluded.

dod.scope: In-memory only; event emission disabled; fixtures and validation excluded from algorithm pairs, included in createRecords except fixture generation. Heap snapshots are not peak heap or total allocated bytes.
